# `^GB` – Graphic Box

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/comparisons/README.md)


Draw a graphic box/line with width, height, border thickness, color, and corner rounding (0=none to 8=heaviest).

Reference parameters: **w, h, t, c, r**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 210](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
